purpose.domain_detail: Baseball statistics web application - at-bat query and video playback system for a baseball league database
purpose.summary: This is an ASP.NET Web Forms code-behind page written in Micro Focus OO COBOL for .NET. It implements a baseball at-bat statistics viewer that queries a player/game database, filters at-bats by date, pitcher, batter, team, inning, and other criteria, and returns video paths for selected at-bats via an ICallbackEventHandler (AJAX callback) mechanism.
